checklist.summary: Request hearing time by email to Brittany Smith, copying opposing counsel, using the Bay case number/style in the subject and supplying the motion, time needed and counsel details. Clear and confirm dates; await assistant confirmation before filing the hearing notice and email the filed notice. Use Central Time; keep the assistant out of interparty scheduling chains. Short motion-calendar hearings require reserved/confirmed slots; the source excludes jury-trial weeks and shifts Monday holidays to Tuesday.

The source requires good-faith certification for most motions and describes its requirement as broader than Rule 1.202. An unanswered email alone is insufficient; it calls for at least two calls in the stated no-response circumstances. Exceptions cover truly dispositive motions, emergencies preventing attempted contact (not delay-created emergencies), and posttrial/postjudgment motions; technical dismissal motions likely permitting amendment still require conferral. No determination of controlling authority is made.

Request a OneDrive folder with email addresses for all parties/counsel needing access; upload separate PDFs, not ZIP files. Do not email hearing documents. Page12 states materials and folder requests at least two business days before hearing, but paragraph2h says uploads complete one business day before. Page12 prohibits mailed hardcopies unless the assistant directs; page13 permits hardcopy when OneDrive is impossible with receipt two business days before. These differing statements are preserved without reconciliation.

Submit Word orders through the portal in the specified DJCMA format, omitting the assistant service-certification portions, with a PDF cover letter stating agreement status and no hidden formatting. Only cover letter/order ordinarily go through that route, with the stated pretrial-stipulation witness/exhibit-list exception. Preserve the required service paragraph and counsel service responsibility for unregistered parties; the office does not mail orders.

The guide addresses hearing materials rather than a separate named courtesy-copy procedure. Documents already accessible in the court file ordinarily need not be resubmitted; preserve the exception for incorporated or hard-to-identify documents. Follow the qualified OneDrive/hardcopy instructions above.

Motion-calendar hearings use Zoom. For matters not yet set as of the source update, specially set hearings are in person unless the court grants Zoom permission; an out-of-county office alone is not grounds. The Zoom instructions apply only to scheduled/permitted Zoom appearances and require video unless impossible, with login five minutes early.

Email cancellations promptly to the assistant; a court-ordered trial or hearing cannot be cancelled merely by filing notice without court approval. Where the case’s standing order requires certification of reading the order and procedures, follow that order’s time periods. Do not infer a separate assistant telephone from the office number.

conflicts.issue: Page12 requires submission at least2businessdays before hearing and requests OneDrive link at least2businessdays; paragraph2h says all uploads completed1businessday before. Preserve separately without choosing deadline.

Page12 prohibits mailing hardcopies unless specifically directed by assistant; page13 allows hardcopy if OneDrive impossible with receipt2businessdays prior. Preserve both qualifications, not unrestricted hardcopy option.
Specially set hearings stated minimum35minutes while later paragraph says15minute increments. Do not silently normalize.
